title: Key Laboratory of Synthetic and Biological Colloids, Jiangnan University
content: Aerogel University Research Platform. The Key Laboratory of Synthetic and Biological Colloids at Jiangnan University is a university laboratory focused on colloids, interfaces, and functional materials. Its official research includes ceramifiable polymer aerogels for thermal protection, making it relevant for aerogel materials design and related testing work.
